_comment: The local sites the FunSync server serves on its own port (5300): each Rust site runs on 127.0.0.1:<port> (`funsync-server --supervise` starts it) and the server relays <prefix>/… to it (crates/funsync-server/src/sites.rs); <prefix>/ is the site's <home> page. The nav bar on every page lists them after the web remote, each followed by its <pages> (a page of that site with a nav link of its own: <prefix><path>, and the server's <path> redirects there).
